groups.sentence: Instructors may permit AI summarization of readings or content they have provided, as set in course policies.
Students may use AI to summarize readings, articles and sources to get an overview and aid understanding.
Students must not use AI to summarize or contextualize assigned readings or source materials.
Summarizing and condensing documents or readings is a use of AI and can be beneficial.
Students should not use AI to do the readings, replace reading course materials, or synthesize learning from them.
Students may use AI to summarize sources only with instructor approval, or for their own or supplementary materials.
Students must not use AI to summarize or respond to readings unless the instructor explicitly permits it.
Students may use AI to summarize readings if they write their own synthesis and cite accordingly, or verify the summary.
